**Training Data: Boris Cherny — Coding's Printing Press Moment**
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOhHNjZItNnMm5tdW61JpnyxeYH5NDDx8

Boris Cherny, the creator of Claude Code, spoke at Code with Claude. The core revelation: Boris now writes **0 lines of code by hand**. He does **"a few dozen PRs every day"**, with a personal record of **150 PRs in a single day**. His setup: 5–10 Claude sessions on his phone, each running multiple agents — "a few hundred" during the day, **a few thousand running overnight** doing deep work.

The tool he's most excited about: **`/loop`** — using Claude's Cron to schedule recurring agent jobs. He has dozens of loops running continuously: one babysitting PRs and fixing CI, one auto-rebasing, one grabbing Twitter feedback and clustering it every 30 minutes. "Loops are the future."

On Claude Code's origin: it was built "pre-PMF" intentionally — they knew the model wasn't ready, so they were building for the *next* model. The exponential growth only started with **Opus 4 in May**, and has inflected with every model release since.

On the future of teams: the rise of **cross-disciplinary generalists** — not just "iOS + web + server" engineers, but people who are great at engineering *and* design *and* product. On the Claude Code team, every single person — product managers, designers, data scientists, finance — writes code.

**Training Data：Boris Cherny — 编程的印刷机时刻**
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOhHNjZItNnMm5tdW61JpnyxeYH5NDDx8

Claude Code 的创造者 Boris Cherny 在 Code with Claude 活动上做了分享。最核心的一个事实：Boris 现在**一行代码都不手写**。他每天做**"几十个 PR"**，个人纪录是**一天 150 个 PR**。他的工作方式：手机上开 5~10 个 Claude 会话，每个会话里跑多个 Agent——白天"几百个"，每晚**几千个 Agent 在跑深度任务**。

他最兴奋的工具：**`/loop`** — 用 Claude 的 Cron 调度周期性 Agent 任务。他同时有几十个循环在跑：一个盯着 PR 修 CI，一个自动 rebase，一个每 30 分钟抓 Twitter 反馈并聚类。"循环就是未来。"

关于 Claude Code 的诞生：它是刻意在"PMF 之前"构建的——他们清楚模型还没准备好，所以是在为*下一个模型*构建产品。真正的指数增长始于 **Opus 4 发布的五月**，此后每次模型发布都进一步拐点。

关于团队的未来：**跨学科通才**的崛起——不只是"iOS + Web + 后端"工程师，而是能同时精通工程、设计和产品的人。Claude Code 团队里每一个人——产品经理、设计师、数据科学家、财务——都在写代码。

Key quotes from Dario and Daniela's session at Code with Claude:

"I've been training these models since 2015 — they were really dumb."

"Build for the exponential. There are products not possible with the current model but could work with later models. This puts a premium on internal experimentation."

"The ways in which we are making models smarter today are much more evident in agentic and Claude Code workflows than chatbots."

"Models are evolving from coding → software engineering → just growing a business."

"It's easy to accumulate extraordinary internal tech debt when you ship that fast. But the models can also help you pay it down."

Anthropic saw **80x growth** in usage and revenue earlier this year. Dario: "That's why we are going to keep acquiring as much compute as we can."

**Dario & Daniela：为指数级增长而构建** — @petergyang

来自 Code with Claude 活动的关键语录：

"我从 2015 年就开始训练这些模型了——那时候真的很蠢。"

"为指数级增长而构建。有些产品现在的模型做不到，但未来的模型可以。这让内部实验的价值极高。"

"我们让模型变聪明的方式，在 Agentic 工作流和 Claude Code 里体现得远比聊天机器人明显。"

"模型的进化路径：写代码 → 软件工程 → 直接经营一家公司。"

"快速发布时很容易积累大量技术债。但模型也能帮你还债。"

Anthropic 今年早些时候实现了使用量和营收的 **80 倍增长**。Dario："这就是为什么我们要持续获取尽可能多的算力。"

The alignment between the SpaceX/Colossus deal (announced yesterday) and this public commitment is not a coincidence.
